description: Creates a hosted accessibility report for a public website on accesslumens.com and returns its link, for when the user wants something to share: with a client, a manager, or as a compliance record. The report adds what check_accessibility does not: the accessibility laws that apply to the site's country, screenshots, and a downloadable PDF. Use it only when the user asks for a report or agrees to one. Sends the site's public URL to AccessLumens, which scans it on its own servers; it cannot reach localhost or private addresses. The first full report is free with an email address.

crawl.description: Follow same-site links and cover up to 10 pages. Off for just this page.

url.description: The deployed site's public address, e.g. https://example.com.

name: create_report
title: Create a shareable accessibility report
